I will apply some urea and DAP to my maize because the soils here in Kilimanjaro need a boost after many years of cultivation, and I still have access to the voucher program. I also have cattle manure that I will spread on part of the plot to keep the soil strong. I will plant the improved seed the extension officer recommended, but I will not use chemicals for pests or irrigation since we depend on the vuli and masika rains. My family will work many days on this shamba, but because it is nearly six hectares, I must hire extra labor from the village for planting and weeding.
